mysteries.title: The Bermuda Triangle
mysteries.subtitle: Where ships and aircraft vanish into legend.
mysteries.description: One of the world's most famous maritime mysteries, associated with unexplained disappearances.
story: The Bermuda Triangle is a loosely defined region of the Atlantic Ocean between Florida, Bermuda and Puerto Rico. For decades, it has been associated with stories of ships and aircraft disappearing under mysterious circumstances.
One of its most famous incidents occurred in December 1945, when five US Navy aircraft disappeared during a training mission known as Flight 19. A rescue aircraft also disappeared during the search.
Over time, writers connected different maritime and aviation accidents to the region, creating a legend involving magnetic anomalies, supernatural forces and even extraterrestrial activity.
However, scientific and maritime authorities have found no convincing evidence that disappearances occur more frequently in this area than in other heavily travelled ocean regions.

timeline.event: Flight 19 disappears during a training mission.
The term Bermuda Triangle becomes widely popularized.
Books and documentaries transform the region into a worldwide mystery.

evidence.title: Flight 19
evidence.description: Five US Navy aircraft disappeared during a training mission in December 1945.

evidence.title: Historical accident records
evidence.description: Documented incidents exist, but they do not establish an unusual concentration of disappearances.

unansweredQuestions: What exactly happened to Flight 19?
Why did the Bermuda Triangle become such a powerful legend?

mysteries.title: The Lost Tomb of Cleopatra
mysteries.subtitle: Where is Egypt's last queen buried?
mysteries.description: The final resting place of Cleopatra VII remains one of archaeology's greatest unanswered questions.
story: Cleopatra VII was the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt. After her defeat by Octavian, she died in Alexandria in 30 BCE.
Ancient historical accounts suggest that Cleopatra was buried alongside Mark Antony. However, the exact location of their tomb has never been conclusively identified.
Parts of ancient Alexandria were transformed by earthquakes, coastal changes and centuries of construction. Some archaeological areas are now underwater or beneath the modern city.

Researchers have investigated several possible locations, including the temple complex of Taposiris Magna. Although important discoveries have been made in the region, no confirmed tomb of Cleopatra has been found.

timeline.event: Cleopatra VII dies in Alexandria.
Historical writers describe her burial alongside Mark Antony.
Archaeological investigations search for her lost burial place.

evidence.title: Ancient historical accounts
evidence.description: Ancient writers describe Cleopatra's death and burial, although their accounts were written after the events.

evidence.title: Taposiris Magna excavations
evidence.description: Archaeologists have uncovered ancient structures and objects, but none conclusively identifies Cleopatra's tomb.

unansweredQuestions: Where was Cleopatra buried?
Could her tomb lie beneath modern Alexandria?
Was the tomb destroyed or submerged?

mysteries.title: Setealém
mysteries.subtitle: What if another reality existed alongside ours?
mysteries.description: A Brazilian urban legend about a disturbing parallel world that people supposedly enter by accident.
story: Setealém is a Brazilian urban legend describing a strange reality that supposedly exists alongside our own.
According to stories shared online, some people claim to have accidentally entered this world through ordinary places such as buses, streets or buildings.
The accounts describe familiar-looking cities with unsettling differences, unusual inhabitants and an overwhelming feeling that something is wrong.
Some stories involve people struggling to return to their normal reality. Others describe brief encounters with places that seem to exist outside ordinary space and time.
There is no independently verified evidence that Setealém exists. The stories are best understood as modern Brazilian internet folklore.

timeline.event: Stories describing Setealém circulate through Brazilian online communities.
The legend spreads through videos, social media and online storytelling.

evidence.title: Online testimonies
evidence.description: Stories published by people claiming to have experienced Setealém. These accounts are not independently verified.

evidence.title: Internet folklore
evidence.description: The legend has developed through online storytelling and shared fictional narratives.

unansweredQuestions: Why do people share stories about parallel realities?
Could unusual memories and dreams influence these experiences?
How did the Setealém legend become popular?

mysteries.title: The Lost City of Atlantis
mysteries.subtitle: The civilization swallowed by the sea.
mysteries.description: A legendary civilization described by Plato that supposedly disappeared beneath the ocean.
story: Atlantis is one of history's most famous lost civilizations. Its story originates in the writings of the ancient Greek philosopher Plato.
Plato described a powerful island civilization that eventually fell into moral decline and was destroyed by catastrophic natural events.
For centuries, explorers and writers have searched for a real location that could have inspired the story.
Some researchers have suggested connections to ancient Mediterranean civilizations, particularly the Minoans. However, no archaeological evidence confirms that Atlantis existed as Plato described it.

timeline.event: Plato describes Atlantis in his dialogues.
Numerous proposed locations and interpretations become popular.

evidence.title: Plato's dialogues
evidence.description: The earliest surviving written account of Atlantis appears in Plato's works.

evidence.title: Archaeological investigations
evidence.description: No archaeological discovery has conclusively established the existence of Atlantis.

unansweredQuestions: Was Atlantis entirely fictional?
Could a real natural disaster have inspired the legend?

mysteries.title: Flight MH370
mysteries.subtitle: 239 people. One aircraft. No final answer.
mysteries.description: A passenger aircraft disappeared in 2014, becoming one of aviation's greatest mysteries.
story: On March 8, 2014, Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370 departed Kuala Lumpur for Beijing with 239 people aboard.
Less than an hour after departure, the aircraft disappeared from civilian air traffic control radar. Subsequent analysis indicated that it had continued flying for several hours.
Satellite communications data suggested a route ending in the southern Indian Ocean. Extensive international searches followed.
Pieces of aircraft debris were later discovered along coastlines in the western Indian Ocean, but the main wreckage and flight recorders have not been recovered.
The exact circumstances surrounding the aircraft's disappearance remain unresolved.

timeline.event: MH370 disappears during its flight to Beijing.
Aircraft debris is discovered on Réunion Island.
Searches and investigations continue without locating the main wreckage.

evidence.title: Satellite communication data
evidence.description: Satellite signals helped investigators estimate the aircraft's possible flight path.

evidence.title: Recovered debris
evidence.description: Aircraft components found in the Indian Ocean region provide evidence of the aircraft's fate.

unansweredQuestions: What caused the aircraft to change course?
Where is the main wreckage?
What happened during its final hours?

mysteries.title: The Wow! Signal
mysteries.subtitle: A message from beyond Earth?
mysteries.description: A mysterious radio signal detected in 1977 whose origin remains unconfirmed.
story: On August 15, 1977, the Big Ear radio telescope at Ohio State University detected an unusually strong narrowband radio signal.
Astronomer Jerry Ehman later noticed the signal in a computer printout and wrote the word Wow! beside the data.
The signal lasted approximately 72 seconds and appeared to originate from the direction of Sagittarius.
Despite repeated observations, the same signal has never been conclusively detected again.
Its source remains unknown. Scientists have proposed natural and human-made explanations, but there is no confirmed evidence that it originated from extraterrestrial intelligence.

timeline.event: The Big Ear telescope detects the unusual signal.
Researchers attempt to identify its origin.

evidence.title: Original signal printout
evidence.description: The recorded data contains the famous sequence associated with the Wow! Signal.

evidence.title: Radio observations
evidence.description: Follow-up searches have not conclusively reproduced the original signal.

unansweredQuestions: What produced the signal?
Why was it never detected again?
Could it have originated from an astronomical phenomenon?

mysteries.title: The Voynich Manuscript
mysteries.subtitle: The book nobody can read.
mysteries.description: An illustrated manuscript written in an undeciphered writing system.
story: The Voynich Manuscript is a mysterious illustrated book written in an unknown script.
Radiocarbon dating places its parchment in the early fifteenth century.
Its pages contain unusual plants, astronomical diagrams, human figures and complex arrangements of symbols.
The manuscript became widely known after book dealer Wilfrid Voynich acquired it in 1912.
Linguists, historians and cryptographers have studied the text for decades, but no proposed translation has achieved general acceptance.

timeline.event: The parchment used for the manuscript is produced.
Wilfrid Voynich acquires the manuscript.
Researchers continue attempting to interpret the writing.

evidence.title: Radiocarbon dating
evidence.description: Scientific analysis dates the parchment to the early fifteenth century.

evidence.title: Unknown writing system
evidence.description: The manuscript contains repeated symbols and patterns whose meaning remains disputed.

unansweredQuestions: Who wrote the manuscript?
What language or system does it contain?
What was its original purpose?

mysteries.title: The Loch Ness Monster
mysteries.subtitle: What lies beneath the surface?
mysteries.description: The legendary creature supposedly inhabiting Scotland's Loch Ness.
story: Loch Ness is a deep freshwater lake in the Scottish Highlands, famous for stories of a mysterious creature known as Nessie.
Modern international interest increased during the 1930s, when newspapers reported alleged sightings.
Photographs, eyewitness accounts and sonar searches helped transform the legend into a worldwide phenomenon.
One of the most famous photographs, known as the Surgeon's Photograph, was later revealed to be a hoax.
Scientific investigations have not produced reliable evidence of an unknown large animal living in the lake.

timeline.event: Modern reports bring the Loch Ness Monster international attention.
The famous Surgeon's Photograph is published.
The photograph is publicly exposed as a hoax.

evidence.title: Eyewitness reports
evidence.description: Numerous people have reported unusual shapes or movements in the lake.

evidence.title: Scientific surveys
evidence.description: Sonar and environmental DNA investigations have not confirmed an unknown large creature.

unansweredQuestions: What explains the reported sightings?
Why has the legend survived for so long?

mysteries.title: The Great Pyramid of Giza
mysteries.subtitle: An ancient engineering masterpiece.
mysteries.description: The construction and internal architecture of the Great Pyramid continue to inspire research.
story: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built during the reign of Pharaoh Khufu in ancient Egypt.
Constructed from millions of stone blocks, it remains one of the most impressive engineering achievements of the ancient world.
Archaeological evidence shows that skilled Egyptian workers organized the construction using sophisticated planning and transportation methods.
However, researchers continue investigating the precise techniques used to move and position the largest stones.
Modern scanning technologies have also identified previously unknown internal spaces, raising new questions about the pyramid's architecture.

timeline.event: The Great Pyramid is constructed.
Muon imaging reveals a previously unknown large internal void.

evidence.title: Workers' settlements
evidence.description: Archaeological discoveries provide evidence of the workforce and organization behind pyramid construction.

evidence.title: Muon scanning
evidence.description: Modern imaging has identified hidden spaces within the structure.

unansweredQuestions: Which construction techniques were used at every stage?
What purposes did the newly detected internal spaces serve?

mysteries.title: The Dyatlov Pass Incident
mysteries.subtitle: Nine hikers. One frozen mountain.
mysteries.description: The mysterious deaths of nine hikers in the Ural Mountains.
story: In February 1959, nine experienced hikers died during an expedition in the northern Ural Mountains.
Search teams discovered their tent damaged and abandoned. Some of the hikers had left without adequate clothing for the freezing conditions.
Their bodies were found in different locations, and several had suffered serious injuries.
The unusual circumstances inspired decades of speculation involving military experiments, unexplained forces and other theories.
More recent scientific investigations have supported natural explanations, including a possible slab avalanche and subsequent exposure to extreme cold.

timeline.event: The hiking group dies during the expedition.
Search teams discover the abandoned tent and bodies.
Scientific research investigates avalanche-related explanations.

evidence.title: Abandoned tent
evidence.description: The tent was found damaged, with evidence that the group had left it unexpectedly.

evidence.title: Injuries and environmental conditions
evidence.description: Medical findings and weather conditions have been examined in later investigations.

unansweredQuestions: What caused the hikers to leave their tent?
Can natural explanations account for all the evidence?

mysteries.title: The Mary Celeste
mysteries.subtitle: The ship that sailed without its crew.
mysteries.description: A merchant ship discovered abandoned in the Atlantic Ocean.
story: In December 1872, the merchant ship Mary Celeste was discovered drifting in the Atlantic Ocean.
The vessel was seaworthy enough to remain afloat, but its captain, crew and passengers were missing.
The ship's lifeboat was gone, suggesting that those aboard may have abandoned the vessel.
Investigators considered several explanations, including severe weather, equipment problems and concerns about the ship's cargo.
No definitive evidence has established what happened to the people aboard.

timeline.event: Mary Celeste departs New York.
The ship is discovered abandoned.

evidence.title: Missing lifeboat
evidence.description: The absence of the ship's small boat suggests that the crew may have abandoned the vessel.

evidence.title: Ship condition
evidence.description: The vessel was found afloat, with much of its cargo still aboard.

unansweredQuestions: Why did the crew abandon the ship?
What happened after they left?

mysteries.title: The Nazca Lines
mysteries.subtitle: Messages written across the desert.
mysteries.description: Enormous ancient geoglyphs whose complete purpose remains debated.
story: The Nazca Lines are a collection of enormous geoglyphs created in the desert of southern Peru.
The designs include animals, plants, geometric shapes and long straight lines.
They were produced by removing darker surface stones to reveal lighter ground beneath.
Archaeologists associate many of the figures with the Nazca culture and have proposed ceremonial, social and religious functions.
Although their human origin is well established, the exact meaning of every design remains uncertain.

timeline.event: Nazca communities create large desert geoglyphs.
Aerial observation brings the figures international attention.

evidence.title: Archaeological context
evidence.description: The geoglyphs are associated with ancient cultures of southern Peru.

evidence.title: Construction methods
evidence.description: The figures were made by removing surface stones from the desert.

unansweredQuestions: What did each figure represent?
How were the lines used in ancient ceremonies?

mysteries.title: The Flannan Isles Lighthouse
mysteries.subtitle: Three keepers. An empty lighthouse.
mysteries.description: Three lighthouse keepers disappeared from a remote Scottish island.
story: In December 1900, three lighthouse keepers disappeared from the Flannan Isles, a remote group of islands off Scotland.
When a relief vessel arrived, the lighthouse was unattended and the men were nowhere to be found.
Investigators discovered evidence of severe weather and damage near the landing area.
The most widely accepted explanation is that the men were swept into the sea by powerful waves.
Their bodies were never recovered, leaving some details of the tragedy unknown.

timeline.event: The three lighthouse keepers disappear.
A relief crew discovers the lighthouse abandoned.

evidence.title: Storm damage
evidence.description: Damage near the landing area suggested the presence of extremely powerful waves.

evidence.title: Official investigation
evidence.description: Investigators concluded that the men were probably swept into the sea.

unansweredQuestions: What sequence of events led to the disappearance?
Why were all three keepers exposed to the danger?

mysteries.title: The Mothman
mysteries.subtitle: The creature seen before disaster.
mysteries.description: A mysterious winged creature reported in West Virginia during the 1960s.
story: In 1966, residents of Point Pleasant, West Virginia, began reporting sightings of a strange winged figure.
Witnesses described a large creature with glowing red eyes, although accounts varied.
The sightings became associated in popular culture with the collapse of the Silver Bridge in 1967.
Some stories portrayed the creature as a supernatural warning of disaster.
No reliable evidence has established the existence of an unknown creature. The Mothman remains a famous example of modern American folklore.

timeline.event: Reports of the Mothman attract public attention.
The Silver Bridge collapses.

evidence.title: Witness accounts
evidence.description: Several people reported seeing an unusual winged figure.

evidence.title: Historical bridge collapse
evidence.description: The Silver Bridge disaster was real, but no evidence links it to a supernatural creature.

unansweredQuestions: What did the witnesses see?
How did the creature become connected to the bridge disaster?

mysteries.title: Amelia Earhart's Disappearance
mysteries.subtitle: The flight that never returned.
mysteries.description: The pioneering aviator disappeared during an attempt to fly around the world.
story: Amelia Earhart was one of the most famous aviators of the twentieth century.
In July 1937, she and navigator Fred Noonan disappeared while attempting to reach Howland Island during a flight around the world.
Radio communications indicated that the aircraft was experiencing difficulties locating the island.
A major search operation failed to find the aircraft.
The leading explanation is that the plane ran out of fuel and crashed into the Pacific Ocean, although its exact location remains unknown.

timeline.event: Earhart begins her world flight attempt.
Earhart and Noonan disappear near Howland Island.

evidence.title: Radio transmissions
evidence.description: Communications provide information about the aircraft's final known position and navigation difficulties.

evidence.title: Search records
evidence.description: Contemporary search operations failed to locate the aircraft.

unansweredQuestions: Where did the aircraft crash?
Could any physical remains still be recovered?

mysteries.title: The Hoia Baciu Forest
mysteries.subtitle: The forest of unsettling stories.
mysteries.description: A Romanian forest famous for unusual trees and paranormal folklore.
story: Hoia Baciu is a forest near Cluj-Napoca in Romania.
Its unusual tree shapes and atmospheric appearance have made it a popular setting for paranormal stories.
Visitors have reported strange sensations, unexplained lights and unusual experiences.
Some legends describe disappearances or mysterious encounters, but these claims lack reliable verification.
The forest has become a destination for visitors interested in folklore and supernatural mysteries.

timeline.event: The forest gains a reputation for paranormal stories.
Tourism and online media spread its mysterious reputation.

evidence.title: Unusual vegetation
evidence.description: The forest contains trees with distinctive shapes.

evidence.title: Visitor testimonies
evidence.description: Paranormal experiences have been reported but are not independently verified.

unansweredQuestions: What explains the unusual tree shapes?
Why has the forest developed such a supernatural reputation?

mysteries.title: The Antikythera Mechanism
mysteries.subtitle: The ancient machine ahead of its time.
mysteries.description: An extraordinary ancient Greek mechanism used to model astronomical cycles.
story: The Antikythera Mechanism was discovered in a shipwreck near the Greek island of Antikythera in 1901.
The surviving fragments contain an intricate system of bronze gears.
Researchers have established that the device was designed to calculate astronomical cycles and predict celestial events.
Its sophistication demonstrates the remarkable engineering knowledge of the ancient Greek world.
Although much of its function is understood, researchers continue investigating its original design and missing components.

timeline.event: The mechanism is believed to have been manufactured.
Fragments are recovered from the Antikythera shipwreck.

evidence.title: Bronze gears
evidence.description: Surviving mechanical components reveal an advanced system of calculations.

evidence.title: Ancient inscriptions
evidence.description: Text on the mechanism provides clues about its astronomical functions.

unansweredQuestions: Who designed the mechanism?
What did its missing components look like?

mysteries.title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke
mysteries.subtitle: A settlement that vanished from history.
mysteries.description: An English colony was found abandoned, leaving questions about its inhabitants.
story: In 1587, English settlers established a colony on Roanoke Island in present-day North Carolina.
Governor John White returned to England for supplies but was delayed for several years.
When he returned in 1590, the settlement had been abandoned.
The word CROATOAN was found carved into a post, suggesting a possible connection to a nearby Indigenous community.
Historians have proposed that the colonists relocated or integrated with local populations, but their precise fate remains uncertain.

timeline.event: English settlers establish the colony.
John White returns and finds the settlement abandoned.

evidence.title: CROATOAN inscription
evidence.description: A carved word suggested a possible destination or connection to a nearby community.

evidence.title: Historical records
evidence.description: Documents describe the settlement and the circumstances of its abandonment.

unansweredQuestions: Where did the colonists go?
Did they join nearby Indigenous communities?

mysteries.title: ʻOumuamua
mysteries.subtitle: A visitor from another star system.
mysteries.description: The first recognized interstellar object observed passing through our Solar System.
story: In October 2017, astronomers discovered an object moving through the Solar System on a trajectory indicating an origin beyond it.
Named ʻOumuamua, it became the first recognized interstellar object of its kind.
Observations suggested unusual physical characteristics and a small non-gravitational acceleration.
Scientists proposed several natural explanations involving the object's composition and behavior.
Some speculative discussions suggested artificial origins, but no evidence has established that ʻOumuamua was extraterrestrial technology.

timeline.event: ʻOumuamua is discovered.
Scientists investigate models explaining its motion and physical properties.

evidence.title: Interstellar trajectory
evidence.description: Its observed orbit indicates that it originated outside the Solar System.

evidence.title: Unusual acceleration
evidence.description: Astronomers measured motion requiring explanation beyond gravity alone.

unansweredQuestions: What was ʻOumuamua made of?
What physical process caused its unusual acceleration?

mysteries.title: The Lead Masks Case
mysteries.subtitle: Two bodies. Two masks. One cryptic note.
mysteries.description: Two men were found dead in Brazil wearing mysterious lead eye masks.
story: In August 1966, the bodies of two Brazilian men were discovered on a hill near Niterói.
Both men were wearing unusual lead masks over their eyes.
Investigators also found a cryptic note containing instructions involving a specific time and the use of capsules.
The circumstances suggested that the men may have been participating in an unusual experiment or ritual.
The case became associated with theories involving spiritualism and UFO-related beliefs, but no definitive explanation for their deaths was established.

timeline.event: The two men are found dead near Niterói.
Investigators examine the masks, note and surrounding circumstances.

evidence.title: Lead eye masks
evidence.description: Both men were found wearing masks made from lead.

evidence.title: Cryptic note
evidence.description: A written message contained unusual instructions involving timing and capsules.

unansweredQuestions: Why were the men wearing lead masks?
What was the purpose of the instructions?
What caused their deaths?

mysteries.title: The Varginha Incident
mysteries.subtitle: Brazil's most famous alien encounter.
mysteries.description: A famous Brazilian story involving alleged sightings of an extraterrestrial creature.
story: In January 1996, residents of Varginha, Brazil, reported sightings of a strange creature.
The story quickly attracted national attention, with rumors claiming that authorities had captured an extraterrestrial being.
Witness accounts and media coverage transformed the incident into one of Brazil's most famous UFO stories.
Investigations and skeptical analyses have challenged the extraordinary claims.
No independently verified evidence has established that an extraterrestrial creature was present.

timeline.event: Reports of an unusual creature emerge in Varginha.
The incident becomes a major part of Brazilian UFO folklore.

evidence.title: Witness testimonies
evidence.description: Several people described unusual sightings, although accounts differed.

evidence.title: Media reports
evidence.description: Contemporary coverage documented the development of the story.

unansweredQuestions: What did the witnesses actually see?
How did rumors of a military operation develop?

mysteries.title: The Oak Island Mystery
mysteries.subtitle: The treasure that may not exist.
mysteries.description: A Canadian island associated with centuries of treasure-hunting stories.
story: Oak Island, located in Nova Scotia, Canada, has attracted treasure hunters for generations.
According to popular accounts, an unusual depression discovered in the late eighteenth century inspired excavations.
Stories developed about underground tunnels, hidden chambers and valuable treasure.
Various searches have uncovered objects and structures, but claims about a vast secret treasure remain unproven.
The island continues to attract attention through books, documentaries and television.

timeline.event: Early treasure-hunting stories emerge.
Excavation attempts expand.
New investigations and media coverage continue.

evidence.title: Historical excavations
evidence.description: Numerous documented searches have taken place on the island.

evidence.title: Recovered objects
evidence.description: Various objects have been discovered, but none proves the existence of a legendary treasure.

unansweredQuestions: Was valuable treasure ever buried on the island?
What explains the underground features reported by excavators?

mysteries.title: The Curse of Tutankhamun
mysteries.subtitle: Did opening the tomb awaken a curse?
mysteries.description: The legendary curse supposedly connected to the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb.
story: In 1922, archaeologist Howard Carter discovered the largely intact tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun.
The discovery became one of the most important archaeological events of the twentieth century.
After the death of Lord Carnarvon, who had financed the excavation, newspapers began promoting stories about an ancient curse.
The legend suggested that disturbing the tomb had brought supernatural punishment upon those involved.
Historical and scientific investigations have not established evidence of a supernatural curse.

timeline.event: Tutankhamun's tomb is discovered.
Lord Carnarvon dies, intensifying stories about a curse.

evidence.title: Historical discovery
evidence.description: The tomb and its contents were extensively documented.

evidence.title: Newspaper coverage
evidence.description: Media reports helped create and spread the curse narrative.

unansweredQuestions: Why did the curse story become so popular?
How did sensational reporting influence public perception?

mysteries.title: The Phaistos Disc
mysteries.subtitle: An ancient message without a translation.
mysteries.description: A Bronze Age clay disc covered with mysterious symbols.
story: The Phaistos Disc was discovered in 1908 at the Minoan palace of Phaistos on Crete.
The clay disc contains a spiral arrangement of symbols impressed into its surface.
The symbols appear to have been created using stamps, making the object especially unusual.
Scholars have proposed numerous interpretations of the inscription.
Because the surviving text is short and its writing system remains uncertain, no translation has gained broad scholarly acceptance.

timeline.event: The disc is created.
The disc is discovered at Phaistos.

evidence.title: Stamped symbols
evidence.description: The disc contains repeated signs arranged in a spiral.

evidence.title: Archaeological context
evidence.description: Its discovery connects it to Bronze Age Crete.

unansweredQuestions: What do the symbols mean?
What language was used?
What was the disc's purpose?

mysteries.title: The Hessdalen Lights
mysteries.subtitle: The lights that appear without warning.
mysteries.description: Unusual luminous phenomena observed in a Norwegian valley.
story: The Hessdalen Valley in Norway is known for reports of unusual lights appearing in the sky.
The phenomenon attracted particular attention during the 1980s, when residents reported numerous sightings.
Researchers have conducted observation projects using cameras and scientific instruments.
Several possible explanations have been proposed, including atmospheric and geological processes.
Some observations remain difficult to classify, although there is no verified evidence of extraterrestrial activity.

timeline.event: Reports of unusual lights increase.
A scientific observation project investigates the phenomenon.

evidence.title: Photographic observations
evidence.description: Some luminous events have been recorded by cameras.

evidence.title: Scientific measurements
evidence.description: Researchers have attempted to measure and classify the observed lights.

Do all reported sightings share the same explanation?

mysteries.title: D. B. Cooper
mysteries.subtitle: The hijacker who disappeared into the night.
mysteries.description: An unidentified hijacker escaped from an aircraft with ransom money.
story: On November 24, 1971, a man using the name Dan Cooper hijacked a commercial aircraft in the United States.
He demanded ransom money and parachutes in exchange for releasing the passengers.
After receiving the ransom, he ordered the aircraft to take off again.
During the flight, Cooper jumped from the aircraft with the money and disappeared.
Despite an extensive FBI investigation, his identity and ultimate fate were never conclusively established.

timeline.event: Cooper hijacks an aircraft and receives ransom money.
He parachutes from the aircraft and disappears.
A portion of the ransom money is discovered.

evidence.title: Witness descriptions
evidence.description: Passengers and crew provided descriptions of the hijacker.

Where did the remaining ransom money go?

mysteries.title: The Yuba County Five
mysteries.subtitle: Five men vanished into the mountains.
mysteries.description: Five men disappeared after attending a basketball game in California.
story: In February 1978, five men from Yuba County, California, disappeared after attending a basketball game.
Their vehicle was later found abandoned in a remote mountain area.
Months later, the remains of four men were discovered in different locations.
One member of the group was never found.
Investigators struggled to explain why the men had travelled into the mountains or what sequence of events led to the tragedy.

timeline.event: The five men disappear.
Their abandoned vehicle is discovered.
Four bodies are recovered.

mysteries.title: The Fermi Paradox
mysteries.subtitle: Where is everybody?
mysteries.description: Why have we found no confirmed evidence of extraterrestrial civilizations?
story: The observable universe contains an enormous number of galaxies, stars and planets.
Given this scale, scientists and philosophers have questioned why humanity has not detected confirmed evidence of extraterrestrial technological civilizations.
The question is commonly associated with physicist Enrico Fermi.
Possible explanations include the rarity of intelligent life, the enormous distances between civilizations and limitations in our ability to detect signals.
The Fermi Paradox remains an important question in discussions about astrobiology and the search for extraterrestrial intelligence.

timeline.event: Enrico Fermi raises the famous question associated with the paradox.
Scientists continue searching for signs of life beyond Earth.

evidence.title: Exoplanet discoveries
evidence.description: Astronomers have confirmed thousands of planets orbiting other stars.

evidence.title: Searches for extraterrestrial signals
evidence.description: Scientific programs have searched for technological signals without confirming an extraterrestrial civilization.

unansweredQuestions: How common is intelligent life?
Could civilizations be too distant to detect?
Are we searching in the right ways?

mysteries.title: The Dancing Plague of 1518
mysteries.subtitle: When a city could not stop dancing.
mysteries.description: A historical episode in which people reportedly danced compulsively in Strasbourg.
story: In 1518, an unusual episode occurred in Strasbourg, then part of the Holy Roman Empire and now located in France.
Historical accounts describe people dancing compulsively in public.
The phenomenon reportedly affected a growing number of individuals over several weeks.
Historians have proposed explanations involving psychological stress, social conditions and collective behavior.
Although the event is documented in historical sources, its exact causes and some details remain debated.

timeline.event: Reports of compulsive dancing emerge in Strasbourg.
The phenomenon reportedly spreads before eventually ending.

evidence.title: Historical records
evidence.description: Contemporary and later accounts describe the unusual dancing episode.

evidence.title: Social conditions
evidence.description: Historians have examined the difficult living conditions of the period.

unansweredQuestions: What triggered the episode?
How much did social and psychological factors contribute?

mysteries.title: The Black-Eyed Children
mysteries.subtitle: Never invite them inside.
mysteries.description: An internet legend about mysterious children with completely black eyes.
story: The Black-Eyed Children are figures from modern internet horror folklore.
Stories describe children or teenagers appearing unexpectedly and asking strangers for help or permission to enter a home.
Their most disturbing feature is said to be their completely black eyes.
The legend became popular through online storytelling and paranormal communities.
There is no reliable evidence that these encounters involve supernatural beings. The stories are generally considered contemporary urban legends.

timeline.event: Early widely circulated online stories describe black-eyed children.
The legend spreads through paranormal websites and internet communities.
